title: Docs link-and-wording pass across the factory corpus
summary: A repository-wide editorial pass over the documentation, plus two comment-only edits in the Rust crate. The substantive changes are: relative links are added or repaired so cross-references between architecture, product, design and vision documents resolve (decision 0001 now points at product decision 0001 and at decisions 0002/0003/0006; the vocabulary draft points at decision 0005; the vision documents point at the SPDLC vision); ambiguous or time-relative wording is replaced with concrete, dated or self-referential phrasing; and one research note gains a three-tier table for SkillEvaluator. No runtime behaviour changes: the only code touched is doc comments in `crates/osf/src/hook.rs` and `crates/osf/tests/skill_lint.rs`, which drop stale 'Change N' prefixes.
